origin.description: Estimate d from a tapered periodogram.

arguments.name: bandw.exp
arguments.text: The number of frequencies is trunc(n to this power). In Python the argument is bandw_exp.

arguments.name: beta
arguments.text: The taper length is trunc(n to this power).

origin.details: The taper is 1 - 6 a^2 (1-a) through half the window and 2 (1-a)^3 through the window. The asymptotic variance uses 0.539285 times the window length over n.
origin.value: d, the asymptotic standard error, and the regression standard error.
origin.example: g <- fdSperio(sin(1:40) + 0.3 * cos((1:40) / 3)); cat(g$d, g$sd.as, g$sd.reg, "\n")
